name: Győrújbarát (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Győrújbarát: a crowned red shield with a white lamb and ears of grain, with a lion crest, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Győrújbarát arms with crown, crest and wreath
